kpis.signal: Indicateur volume cle HCA, integre inpatient + outpatient en equivalent, +2.9% en 2025 reflechit croissance organique solide
kpis.description_fr: Admissions equivalentes = admissions hospitalisees + (outpatient revenue / inpatient revenue per admission). Mesure cle du volume patients HCA.
kpis.description_en: Equivalent admissions = inpatient admissions + (outpatient revenue / inpatient revenue per admission). Key HCA patient volume metric.

kpis.signal: Volume admissions IP en croissance, levier majeur du revenue mix vs outpatient
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total admissions inpatient HCA. Indicateur direct activite hopitaux, exclu freestanding endoscopy. 73% taux d'occupation en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Total HCA inpatient admissions. Direct hospital activity metric, excludes freestanding endoscopy. 73% occupancy rate in 2025.

kpis.signal: Pres de 10M visites ER en 2025, point d'entree majeur du funnel HCA (urgences nourrissent admissions IP)
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total visites aux urgences HCA. Volume reseau ER, predicteur des admissions IP et de la demande hospitaliere.
kpis.description_en: Total HCA ER visits. ER network volume, predictor of IP admissions and hospital demand.

kpis.signal: Chirurgies IP en croissance constante, acte a forte valeur ajoutee, mix favorable pour le revenue per admission
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total chirurgies pratiquees en hospitalisation. Acte premium, contribuent fortement au revenue per equivalent admission et a la marge.
kpis.description_en: Total inpatient surgeries performed. Premium acts, strong contribution to revenue per equivalent admission and margins.

kpis.signal: RN 2025 = 6.78 Mds$ soit 28.33$/action diluee, +17.8%, levier operationnel sur croissance CA +7.1%
kpis.description_fr: Resultat net attribuable a HCA Healthcare apres minoritaires. Inclut gains/pertes sur cessions facilities (37M$ en 2025, 14M$ en 2024).
kpis.description_en: Net income attributable to HCA Healthcare after minority interests. Includes gains/losses on facility sales ($37M in 2025, $14M in 2024).
